title: Mecklenburg Castle

groundCutout.basis: The outline replaces the general terrain only over the surveyed earthwork and its immediate apron.

terrainReference.basis: Current paved Am Burgwall approach immediately north of the earthwork, sampled from the original state DGM.

identities.name: Mecklenburg Castle
identities.address: Am Burgwall, 23972 Dorf Mecklenburg, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Germany

mapIdentity.scope: The native OpenStreetMap archaeological site and 1 metre state bare-earth grid jointly locate the present fortification. No medieval buildings are visible in the released present ground photographs.

note: The unchanged state DGM fixes the surviving ditch, elevated bank, interior basin and modern cutting. Paving and entrance furnishings are based on the direct 2015 photographs.
